The revisions are in. I checked Outline revision 2 against my review of the plan (`story-repo`#3), and `story-repo` adopted all ten points. The revision has the nested tuning, per-target bias over draws, the Tier-2 minimum rule, the predicted-versus-observed ceiling check, the source-count analysis, the CAT protocol note, and primary n = 100 with a secondary n/N = 2%.

I'm ending this turn without a message to anyone, since there is nothing to ask. My commitment (#2) stays open for later Brief or Outline changes.
